auth: proxy (YT_VOICE_AUTH=proxy): the egress proxy adds the key for api.elevenlabs.io; no key is stored or passed
language: en (American English, US viewer; scripts are not translated)
output_format: mp3_44100_128 from the API, converted to 44.1 kHz mono WAV by voice.py

default.name: Adam
default.note: channel narrator in yt-voice; ElevenLabs describes it as 'bright, brash, openly confident', which may be too forceful for a calm science documentary: listen before committing

candidates_for_listening_test.name: Brian
candidates_for_listening_test.labels: male, american, middle_aged, 'Deep, Resonant and Comforting'

candidates_for_listening_test.name: Bill
candidates_for_listening_test.labels: male, american, old, 'Wise, Mature, Balanced', crisp

voice_settings.note: starting values; the API default for Adam is stability 0.5, similarity 0.75, style 0, speed 1.0. Tune only from the sample: target 140-150 words per minute (about 12 minutes total), speed within 0.92-1.05

context_between_chunks: --context (previous_text and next_text, no extra billed characters) so prosody is continuous across chunk joins
chunking: voice.py default 2,500 characters at paragraph then sentence boundaries: 5 requests for 10,518 characters
